tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the wellness journeys, retreats, experiences, sessions, guest-care pages and blog. Returns ids, titles, URLs and a snippet; pass an id to fetch for the full text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full public text of one page (journey itinerary, retreat programme, inclusions, guest care) or a blog article card, with its URL.

tools.name: list_offerings
tools.description: Every journey, retreat, experience and group session with place, duration, the published price label and its kind (from_price, indicative, on_enquiry) and the page URL. Optional type filter: "journey", "retreat", "experience", "session".

tools.name: get_offering
tools.description: One offering in full: structured fields plus the whole page text (day-by-day plan, inclusions, exclusions) and how to book or ask.

tools.name: contact_and_booking
tools.description: How to reach the DharmikVibes wellness desk (WhatsApp, email, enquiry page, partner email) and how booking works. This server cannot book or take payment.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Recent wellness articles from the DharmikVibes blog shown on the site, with date, teaser and link.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, list_offerings, list_blog_posts · Private data: contact_and_booking · Public sink: contact_and_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, list_offerings, list_blog_posts · Private data: contact_and_booking · Public sink: contact_and_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
